Reconnaissance greps (manual, pre-harness) showed two collision families: ADM as a substring of admissible/admits, and weighted as in the D-007/T-514 genericity topologies. v0.2 makes those non-anchoring by construction and pre-registers them as negative controls. title: Field-level primary-source anchor binding audit for F1/F2a/F2b provenance (BL-11 formulation half)

motivation.ask: Formulation: state which schema field each anchor binds, so the anchor is falsifiable per field. Literature: add primary-source anchors for s>5/2, delta in (1/2,1), positive mass, future asymptotic predictability, or reject them so F1 withdraws the dependent fields.
motivation.scope_note: This is an independent measurement artifact, NOT a schema review, NOT a gate verdict, NOT a ledger write. It edits no schema, ledger or map byte.

fail_closed_rule: If any pinned input measures a different sha256 at scan time, abort with exit 2 and write no report. If the positive control does not classify as anchored_theorem, abort with exit 3 and write no report (harness invalid, not ledger finding).

control_expectation.why: D-008/SRC-073 is the ledger's MGHD existence+uniqueness-up-to-isometry entry; a harness that cannot recover it cannot be trusted to report absences for the other items.

classification_rules.anchored_theorem: >=1 L0 theorem row matches a strong_anchor_pattern (with strong_requires_context satisfied when declared) in a binding field (statement_exact,label,assumptions,genericity,topology,does_not_imply,falsifiers,unresolved,scope_caveats); report theorem_ids and their source_ids.
classification_rules.anchored_registry_only: 0 L0 theorem matches AND >=1 L1 registry row matches a strong_anchor_pattern (with context when declared) in title/venue/excerpt/assessment/elided_quote; report citation_ids, status, verdict and used_by_theorems (empty used_by_theorems means the source is registered but unbound to any theorem entry).
classification_rules.weak_match_only: only weak_anchor_patterns match and no strong match exists; counts as NOT anchored, reported separately as a weak signal (e.g. a registered survey that could carry the concept).
classification_rules.keyword_collision_only: all matches are covered by a pre-registered collision_pattern and no strong/weak match exists; counts as NOT anchored, reported separately so an absence claim is not confused with a collision hit.
classification_rules.per_schema_occurrence: every schema text line matching a schema_pattern is an occurrence; occurrences are grouped by item and by the nearest preceding top-level YAML key (the field the anchor must bind).

negative_controls.rule: every literal 'ADM' / 'admit' match inside admissible/admits must be reported as a collision, never as an ITEM-PMT anchor
negative_controls.required: collision count >= 1 in the L0 corpus for the harness to be exercising this control

negative_controls.rule: 'weighted C^1/C^infinity' genericity-topology matches must be reported as collisions for ITEM-SOBOLEV-* and never as Sobolev-regularity anchors

falsifiers: Any pinned input hash differs at scan time (drift): the whole audit is superseded and the harness refuses to emit.
The positive control ITEM-MGHD-CONTROL fails to recover D-008/SRC-073 as anchored_theorem: the harness is invalid.

A human or independent scan finds a primary-source anchor for ITEM-PMT, ITEM-PREDICT, ITEM-SOBOLEV-S or ITEM-SOBOLEV-DELTA in ledger/theorems.jsonl at a1674f094979, or in ledger/citation_audit.csv at 315c19145065, that this audit classified as unanchored or registry-only.
Any schema occurrence of one of the four items outside the paths listed in schema_occurrences (the occurrence census is then incomplete).
